dedupe_keys.name: simulation and analysis code for inventory management for ageing infrastructure when planning horizon becomes the binding constraint

description: Andreas Legård Vedeld at the University of Stavanger publishes a SimPy model of infrastructure inventory management with parallel planned and emergent demand streams. The June 2026 thesis package contains calibration scripts, an experiment runner, replication seeds, R analysis scripts and simulation-output CSV files. Aggregate extracts from Bane NOR business-intelligence reports support descriptive analysis and parameter calibration. Zenodo serves the ZIP archive free under MIT. Its empirical context is Norwegian railway infrastructure; the metadata do not state the underlying reporting dates, component inventory coverage or simulated planning horizons. The model can support simulation of spare-parts demand and inventory policies for ageing infrastructure. Proprietary transaction-level records are explicitly excluded, so users cannot reproduce analyses requiring those original records. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The code was not run.
